rv.q: Anna Dubrovskaya's Elena, stunning in white silk, bowls a circus hoop. Astrov shows her his images of deforestation on a projector with an unmistakably phallic funnel that emits puffs of steam.
But it doesn't have enough passion or intensity.

cn.t: Critics praise this mercurially brilliant Moscow import for its dazzling departure from traditional British realism, though some note the starry cast could deliver greater intensity in Chekhov's classic.
